title: Aparichita
desc: A writer visits his friend's village after he learns about his disappearance. On visiting the place, he discovers that the latter was murdered.

title: Modalne Preethi
desc: A blooming romance between an outgoing young man and an introverted woman falls apart as they shy away from professing their feelings. However, fate unites them in mysterious ways.

title: Chikkejamanru
desc: A sinister man tries to defame the village landlord and create trouble for the village. However, the landlord is determined to stand tough against all the allegations.

title: Akhanda
desc: When the nefarious Varadarajulu plans to attack Murali Krishna, an ardent devotee of Lord Shiva, Akhanda leaves no stone unturned to defeat the evil.

title: Virupaksha
desc: While the occurrence of a series of mysterious deaths haunt the villagers, a man decides to risk his life and unravel the secret behind them.
